newsitem.title: LATVIA: FIRST BROKERS' ASSOCIATION TO BE REGISTERED.
newsitem.headline: FIRST BROKERS' ASSOCIATION TO BE REGISTERED.

text.p: A group of brokers, representing seven of Latvia's largest banks, said an association of brokers will be registered in the company register next week.
"We plan to register the association next week," said Roberts Idelsons, head of the securities department at Trasta Bank and a member of the working group behind the association.
This would make it the first officially registered professional union of securities market players.
The association will unite brokers from a number of leading banks and brokerages, including Unibanka, Saules, Rietumu, Hipoteku un Zemes, Trasta banks, Hansabank-Latvija and Tallinvest.
"We expect to see our membership reach some 100 a couple of weeks after the registration," Idelsons said.
Idelsons said the association could turn into a leading professional organisation for Latvia's brokers, estimated to be around 700.

"It would join professionals representing institutions, which are among the most active finacial intermediaries and generate the biggest turnover both in the bourse and on the free market," Idelsons said.
"The working out of the brokers' code of ethics would be one the main tasks of the organisation," he added.
